name: Cardiology Examination
whatIsIncluded: ECG, blood pressure measurement, heart auscultation.
howItsDone: Non-invasive examination performed by a cardiologist.
specialPreparation: Avoid caffeine and smoking 2 hours before the exam.

name: Heart Ultrasound (Echocardiography)
description: Ultrasound imaging of the heart to assess structure and function.
whatIsIncluded: Detailed ultrasound imaging and cardiologist report.
howItsDone: Ultrasound probe is placed on the chest with gel.

name: Internal Medicine Consultation
description: General health assessment and medical consultation.
whatIsIncluded: Medical history review, basic physical examination.
howItsDone: Face-to-face consultation with an internal medicine specialist.

name: Basic Blood Test Panel
howItsDone: Blood sample taken from a vein.
specialPreparation: Fasting for at least 8 hours is required.

name: Extended Blood Test Panel
whatIsIncluded: CBC, glucose, cholesterol, liver enzymes, kidney function.
howItsDone: Blood sample taken from a vein.
specialPreparation: Fasting for at least 10 hours is required.

name: Neurology Consultation
howItsDone: Clinical neurological assessment by a neurologist.

name: Orthopedic Examination
description: Assessment of bones, joints, and muscles.
whatIsIncluded: Joint mobility tests and physical examination.
howItsDone: Manual examination by an orthopedic specialist.

name: Abdominal Ultrasound
whatIsIncluded: Ultrasound of liver, gallbladder, pancreas, kidneys.
howItsDone: Ultrasound probe used on the abdomen with gel.
specialPreparation: Fasting for at least 6 hours before the exam.
